en.quote: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
en.riddle: till I know what God will do for me.
en.speaker: David

bonus_hint.quote: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

he.quote: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד מִשָּׁם מִצְפֵּה מוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב יֵֽצֵא־נָא אָבִי וְאִמִּי אִתְּכֶם עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵדַע מַה־יַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִֽים
he.speaker: דָּוִד

bonus_hint.quote: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה אֶת־יָבָל הוּא הָיָה אֲבִי יֹשֵׁב אֹהֶל וּמִקְנֶֽה
